verdict.rationale: Oyster is an HR/EOR SaaS platform, so data portability is a fair axis. The evidence never documents a bulk data export, open-format downloads, or an offboarding/exit path. API read endpoints (e.g. 'Retrieve all engagements') and webhooks are developer building blocks that could be used to build an export, not the export capability itself. The 'reports' marketing line is an adjacent feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
